parsed.answer: The evidence shows that the H3K9 demethylases KDM4D and KDM4E mediate active H3K9me3/2 demethylation and are deficiently expressed in bovine SCNT embryos at embryonic genome activation. Overexpression of KDM4E removes the H3K9me3/2 barrier, restores the global transcriptome, improves blastocyst formation, and increases SCNT cloning efficiency, supporting the claim that ectopic H3K9 demethylase expression improves reprogramming efficiency.
